children.text: The Indonesian tourist visa allows the holder a short-term tourist visit to Indonesia.

The Indonesian tourist e-visa application is completed online with the help of the government website, but the main precondition for this is having a sponsor. A sponsor is defined as an Indonesian citizen who has a stable income and no criminal record.

The sponsor must register on a special portal, upload documents, and have the registration verified by the immigration authority. After verification and receiving the necessary information, the sponsor completes the online visa application and pays the visa fee.

page.title: How to apply for a visa?

children.text:
🔹 A detailed list of documents tailored to your travel purpose.
🔹 Professional review of the documentation you provide.
🔹 Phone and online support.
🔹 The highest standard of personal data protection.

🔹 Gathering the required documentation with the help of an Indonesian resident sponsor.
🔹 Paying the visa fee.
🔹 Receiving the visa decision.
Processing of the Indonesian visa application begins once the documents are uploaded and takes 3 to 5 days.
The tourist visa is issued with a validity of 60 days and allows the applicant a single entry into Indonesia for a stay of 30 days.

page.title: How long is the visa valid?

children.text: A valid passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Flight reservation
Proof of accommodation
Make sure to include all required information in your application.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months from your planned return date.
The visa application can be submitted at most 1 month, and at minimum 10 days, before your trip.
It's important to remember and not exceed the rights and obligations granted by your visa category.

content.text: What determines whether I'll get a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your social and economic ties to your home country. Clear proof of your travel purpose is also important.

content.text: What if I don't have a sponsor?

children.text: Unfortunately, without a sponsor it isn't possible to apply for the Indonesia tourist e-visa. However, our consultant and our partner can simplify the process for you and help you through the visa procedure.

content.text: Can the decision on an Indonesia visa be guaranteed or challenged?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the decision on issuing a visa; this decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.

content.text: How long does it take to receive the visa?

children.text: The visa is issued within 3 to 5 business days.
